subject.title: [Bug]: Skill Workshop agent-tool apply times out because approval wait exceeds tool watchdog

question: Which open fix path should own this issue: the narrow Codex timeout increase or the newer broader Skill Workshop approval-flow repair?
rationale: Both open PRs close this issue, but one changes only Codex dynamic-tool timeouts while the newer maintainer-authored PR also changes approval metadata and timeout semantics for the Skill Workshop approval path.

options.title: Prefer the broader approval-flow PR
options.body: Use the newer Skill Workshop approval-flow PR as the canonical fix if maintainers want actionable approval metadata and non-wedging timeout semantics included with the watchdog repair.

options.title: Prefer the narrow timeout PR
options.body: Use the older Codex timeout PR if maintainers want the smallest change that only extends the dynamic-tool watchdog for skill_workshop calls.

options.title: Keep both pending for comparison
options.body: Leave both PRs open until review decides whether the broader behavior is worth the compatibility and security-boundary surface.

recommendation.title: Prefer the broader approval-flow PR
recommendation.body: Use the newer Skill Workshop approval-flow PR as the canonical fix if maintainers want actionable approval metadata and non-wedging timeout semantics included with the watchdog repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the issue, owns much of the recent Codex dynamic-tool history, and authored the newer broader linked PR that closes it.
